content: Destination: Tomb of I'timad-ud-Daulah (Baby Taj), Agra, Uttar Pradesh. Category: Heritage. Interests: Heritage, Architecture, Photography, History. Overview: Often regarded as the draft or jewel box of the Taj Mahal, this elegant mausoleum was built between 1622 and 1628 by Empress Nur Jahan for her father Mirza Ghiyas Beg.
